title: Rental Desk Guidance: Authorizing a Rental under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
**Basis.** A rental under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement is authorized only on a reported physical damage claim of the vehicle that carries the option. The loss must be on or after the option's effective date and must have occurred while the option was active.

## Conditions read from the records

| Condition | Where it is read | Authorized when |
|---|---|---|
| Coverage decision | The latest coverage decision on the physical damage claim with the same claim number | The latest decision is *accepted* |
| Option status | The status of the rental option the rental will be paid under | The status is *active* when the rental is authorized |

A rental is authorized only when the latest coverage decision on the physical damage claim is accepted. The option status must be active when the rental is authorized. If either condition is not met, no rental is authorized. Both are read from the system records, not from the customer's account of the claim.

## Start day

- For a vehicle that can still be driven, the rental starts on the day the vehicle is dropped at the shop for the covered repair.
- For a vehicle that cannot be driven, the rental may start on the day the loss was reported.

## Total theft waiting period

For a total theft, a rental may start no earlier than the option's theft waiting days, counted in calendar days after the theft was reported. The days count from the report date on the theft claim, and the report date is day 0. So with a waiting period of 1, the rental can start on the day after the report. A start day equal to the report date plus the waiting days is in time. Any earlier day is not.

| Waiting days on the option | Theft reported on day 0 | Rental starting on day 0 | Rental starting on day 1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Report date | Too early | Allowed |
| 0 | Report date | Allowed | Allowed |

*Boundary case (hypothetical dates):* A theft is reported on October 3 under an option with a waiting period of 1. A rental starting October 3 is too early. A rental starting October 4 is in time.

## Authorized days of a first authorization

The former clause on the first authorization is no longer in force. It said that the first authorization covers the initial authorization days, or the shop's estimated repair days if fewer, and never more than the days left under the maximum days per loss. The days an authorization covers are now set under the current basis for authorized days, not under this clause.

## Direct billing, larger cars and customer charges

- With direct billing, Cardinal reserves a car of the option's direct-bill class at the partner agency. The customer may take a larger car and pay the difference.
- Before pickup, the customer is told which charges will be theirs.

## When no rental is authorized under the option

- No rental is authorized under this option after the at-fault party's insurer has accepted liability for the rental.
- No rental is authorized once the per-loss maximum or the maximum days are used up.

superseded_clauses: The first authorization covers initial_authorization_days or the shop's estimated repair days if fewer, never more than the days left under max_days_per_loss.
